description: The shipped vocabulary and layout with a lifecycle prompt-name override (change 1zxnw; neutral example names since change 200ex, so no example collides with a distribution's own vocabulary): the container prompts take -batch names and the item prompts -task names, with one alias, and a chain in which the container prompts Implement change and Close change take the slugs and shortcuts the item prompts give up. The council protocol is named Review Board (change 200ew).
